name: Seneca the Younger
role: Roman Stoic philosopher, statesman and dramatist
contribution: A Stoic philosopher of Ancient Rome, a statesman, a dramatist, and in one work a satirist from the post-Augustan age of Latin literature.

checks.lead: Lucius Annaeus Seneca the Younger ( SEN-ik-ə; c. 4 BC – AD 65), usually known mononymously as Seneca, was a Stoic philosopher of Ancient Rome, a statesman, a dramatist, and in one work (Apocolocyntosis) a satirist from the post-Augustan age of Latin literature.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
